مُسْتَرَاحٌ a n. of place: and as such meaning (assumed tropical:) The grave [as being a place of rest or ease]. (Ham p. 228.) [And as such] (assumed tropical:) A privy; syn. مَخْرَجٌ. (S.) ―
-b2- Also, accord. to rule, a n. of time [i. e. A time of rest or ease]. (Ham ubi suprà.) ―
-b3- And a pass. part. n. of 10. (Id. ibid.) [As such] meaning (assumed tropical:) Dead [for مُسْتَرَاحٌ مِنْهُ]; as also ↓ مُسْتَريِحٌ [lit. at rest or ease]. (Id. p. 251.) ―
-b4- And it may also be used as an inf. n. of 10. (Ham p. 228.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
